visual.description: Light warm grey used as the primary page and section background throughout the site.
Near-black used for body text, logo text, and primary foreground elements.
Near-black used for headings and the brand wordmark.
Near-black used for button borders and the horizontal rule divider in the navigation.
Near-black used for navigation logo and text in the top-of-page state.
Light grey background of the navigation bar matching the page background.
Near-black text in the scrolled/opaque navigation state — visually identical to top state.
Light grey navigation background in the scrolled state — visually identical to top state.
Light grey used as the text and border color for the secondary CTA button (email/inquiry button on dark sections).
